import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    final_count = 0
    
    if input_line:
        i = 0
        while i < len(input_line):
            current = input_line[i]
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(input_line) and input_line[j] == current:
                j += 1
            seq_length = j - i
            if seq_length % 2 == 0:
                final_count += 1
            i = j
    
    print(final_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
